title: This Week In Space podcast: Episode 237 — A Fond Farewell
summary: On Episode 237 of This Week In Space, Tariq Malik and Rod Pyle sign off — temporarily — with a look at space news, a bushel of space jokes, and a recap of some of our funniest moments.
contentText:
On Episode 237 of This Week In Space , Tariq Malik and Rod Pyle sign off — temporarily — with a look at space news, a bushel of space jokes, and a recap of some of our funniest moments.

Welcome to the last episode of This Week in Space . It's been a good run — including our betas, we produced about 240 episodes of the show, and had a blast doing it.

We appreciate all of you, our fine listeners, for accompanying us on this journey, and are working to continue in a new venue in early 2027. To track our progress, and get your weekly fix of Rod's terrible space humor, find us on Instagram and Facebook: @rodandtariq

Get episodes ad-free with Club TWiT at https://twit.tv/clubtwit

Space news of the week

- Sir Brian May adds new dimension to Hera asteroid

- Russian Military Satellite’s Approach to American Spacecraft Looked Like a Weapons Operation, US Says

- Google Selects Blue Origin’s New Glenn for Project Suncatcher

- Voyager 1 team, unbowed by communications glitch, celebrates epic 1-light-day distance milestone

- Pakistani astronaut set to become 1st international visitor to China's Tiangong space station this month

About This Week In Space

This Week in Space covers the new space age. Every Friday we take a deep dive into a fascinating topic. What's happening with the new race to the moon and other planets? When will SpaceX really send people to Mars?
